verification_log.method: 3:7–28 Heliodorus sent by King Seleucus for the Temple treasury; 6:2 the sanctuary renamed for Olympian Zeus; 7:9, 14 martyrs' hope of being "raised up"; 9:1–29 Antiochus retreats from Persepolis and dies in the mountains; 10:1–8 the Temple recovered and cleansed on 25 Chislev, sacrifices "after they had ceased for two years"; 11:21, 33, 38 letters dated year 148; 11:23 Antiochus V: "our father passed to the gods"
